symptom_quote: After clicking Send on a draft invoice, the row's status badge still reads 'Draft' until the page is reloaded, even though the invoice was sent.

app_map_writes.value: InvoicesPage at /invoices; list rows render InvoiceRow with an InvoiceStatusBadge per row; web/src/invoices/InvoicesPage.js
[data-testid=invoice-row] — one per invoice; the Send action is [data-testid=invoice-send] inside the row
[data-testid=invoice-status] inside the row; text is the status label ('Draft' | 'Sent' | 'Paid')
copies props.status into local state ONCE on mount and never re-syncs; web/src/invoices/InvoiceStatusBadge.js:9
POST /api/invoices/{id}/send then patches the row in the store to status 'sent'; web/src/invoices/invoicesStore.js:58 — the store IS updated, the badge just does not read it
POST /api/invoices/{id}/send -> 200 {id, status: 'sent', sent_at}; GET /api/invoices/{id} reflects 'sent' immediately
